title: Add phone validation and a registration handler to the extract-function app
description: Backend-feature task on refactor_extract_function: add a shared src/validators.py module with is_valid_email and validate_phone, and add handle_registration to handlers.py. All existing tests must pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Add two new things to the codebase:

1. Create src/validators.py:
   import re
   EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$')
   PHONE_RE = re.compile(r'^\+?[\d\s\-().]{7,}$')
   def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool: ...
   def validate_phone(phone: str) -> bool: ...

2. Add handle_registration to src/handlers.py:
   from src.validators import is_valid_email, validate_phone
   def handle_registration(email: str, name: str, phone: str) -> dict:
       if not is_valid_email(email): raise ValueError(f'Invalid email: {email}')
       if not validate_phone(phone): raise ValueError(f'Invalid phone: {phone}')
       return {'user': name, 'email': email, 'phone': phone}

All 6 existing tests must still pass.
Add tests/test_validators.py for is_valid_email and validate_phone.
required_artifacts: src/validators.py with is_valid_email and validate_phone functions
handle_registration in handlers.py validates both email and phone, returns dict
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (all tests)
uv run python -c "from src.handlers import handle_signup" passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.handlers import handle_signup"
